newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-TURKYILMAZ BACK IN SWISS SQUAD TO FACE HUNGARY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TURKYILMAZ BACK IN SWISS SQUAD TO FACE HUNGARY.

text.p: Key striker Kubilay Turkyilmaz returned from injury to the Swiss squad named on Tuesday for a crucial group three World Cup qualifier against Hungary.
The Grasshopper Zurich forward, who scored twice in his last league match, appears fully recovered from a leg injury that kept him out of a friendly against Latvia on April 2.

He will probably be joined up front for the April 30 clash at Zurich's Harturm stadium by Borussia Dortmund's Stephan Chapuisat, who is expected to return from injury for his club's European Cup semifinal against Manchester United on Wednesday.
Swiss coach Rolf Fringer will be hoping the combination will inspire an attack that has produced just three goals in three matches, all of them in the 3-2 win over Finland.
The midfield will be anchored by Inter Milan's Ciri Sforza and Grasshopper's Murat Yakin.
The one notable absentee from the squad was Hamburg defender Stefan Henchoz, ruled out after recently undergoing surgery on both ankles.
The match is one Switzerland must win if they are to entertain serious thoughts of qualifying for the World Cup finals next year in France.

In three matches the Swiss have just one win leaving them tied with Finland and Azerbaijan on three points. Norway top the group on nine points with an unblemished record followed by Hungary with six.
Defenders - Christophe Ohrel (Lausanne), Ramon Vega (Tottenham), Regis Rotenbuehler (Neuchatel), Raphael Wicky (Sion), Stefan Wolf (Lucerne), Marco Walker (Munich 1860)
Midfielders - Mario Cantaluppi (Servette), Johann Vogel (Grasshopper), Murat Yakin (Grasshopper), Ciri Sforza (Inter Milan)
Attackers - Stephane Chapuisat (Borussia Dortmund), Frederic Chassot (Sion), Marco Grassi (Monaco), Adrian Kunz (Neuchatel), David Sesa (Servette), Kubilay Turkyilmaz (Grasshopper)
